blocks.text: Cloud computing mein scalability hoti hai, yani resources demand ke mutabiq kam zyada kiye ja sakte hain. Lekin faltu kharche se bachne aur behtareen performance (kaam kitna tez aur achha ho raha hai) ke liye resources ki achhi management (resource management) zaroori hai.

items: Scalability: cloud services demand ke mutabiq resources khud barha ya ghata sakti hain, maslan rush ke waqt (peak times) zyada servers jorna aur demand kam hone par unhein kam karna.

Resource Management: sahi management, jaise resources ke istemal ki monitoring (nazar rakhna) aur performance behtar banana (optimizing), kharcha qaboo mein rakhta hai aur cloud resources ka sahi istemal yaqeeni banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar koi cloud resources ki monitoring na kare to kya ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Faltu servers chalte reh sakte hain aur bill barhta rehta hai; ya resources bohat kam hon to service sust ho sakti hai.

items: Scalability: demand ke mutabiq resources up ya down.
Resource management: monitoring aur optimizing se kharcha qaboo mein.
